01

“and other people have helped him with it”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 25:4).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
and other people have helped him with it [al-Furqan 4] he said: "The Jews say it."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَأَعَانَهُ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ آخَرُونَ [الفرقان: 4] قَالَ: «يَهُوَدُ تَقُولُهُ»
Edition record 372874 · p. 496Link to report ↗

A further report

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English

فَقَدْ جَاءُوا ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا قَالَ: " الظُّلْمُ: الْكَذِبُ "

03

“so they cannot [find] a way”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr.

Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
so they cannot [find] a way [al-Isra 48] He says: "they cannot find a way out of the comparisons they have made about you."

فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا [الإسراء: 48] ، يَقُولُ: «لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ مَخْرَجًا يُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ الْأَمْثَالِ الَّتِي ضَرَبُوا لَكَ»

04

“if He willed, He could assign to you better than that”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 25:10).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
if He willed, He could assign to you better than that [al-Furqan 10] meaning: "better" than what they said: gardens beneath which rivers flow [al-Baqara 25]. He said: "The gardens are walled orchards."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
إِنْ شَاءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ [الفرقان: 10] ، يَعْنِي: «خَيْرًا» مِمَّا قَالُوا: جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ [البقرة: 25] قَالَ: " الْجَنَّاتُ: حَوَائِطُ "
Edition record 372877 · p. 496Link to report ↗

05

“And the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides…”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 25:17).

06
Explanation from Mujāhid 06

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides God and say, 'Did you mislead these servants of Mine?' [al-Furqan 17] meaning: "He will say to Jesus, Ezra, and the angels: 'Did you mislead these servants of Mine?'"
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ أَأَنْتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِي هَؤُلَاءِ [الفرقان: 17] ، يَعْنِي: " أَنَّهُ يَقُولُ لِعِيسَى وَعُزَيْرٍ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ: أَأَنْتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِي هَؤُلَاءِ؟ "
Edition record 372879 · p. 496Link to report ↗

07

“So they have denied you in what you say”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 25:19).

08
Explanation from Mujāhid 08

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
So they have denied you in what you say [al-Furqan 19] he said: "God, Mighty and Majestic, says to the polytheists who worshiped Jesus, Ezra, and the angels, when Jesus, Ezra, and the angels said: You are our ally, not them [Saba 41], God, Mighty and Majestic, said to those who worshiped them: So they have denied you in what you say [al-Furqan 19]. He says: Jesus, Ezra, and the angels will call the polytheists liars. So you cannot avert [punishment] [al-Furqan 19]: He says: the polytheists will be unable to avert it, or [find] help [al-Furqan 19]."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُمْ بِمَا تَقُولُونَ [الفرقان: 19] قَالَ: " يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عز وجل لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ الَّذِينَ عَبَدُوا عِيسَى وَعُزَيْرًا، وَالْمَلَائِكَةَ، حِينَ قَالَ عِيسَى وَعُزَيْرٌ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ: أَنْتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِنْ دُونِهِمْ [سبأ: 41] فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عز وجل لِلَّذِينَ عَبَدُوهُمْ: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُمْ بِمَا تَقُولُونَ [الفرقان: 19] يَقُولُ: كَذَبَّكُمْ عِيسَى وَعُزَيْرٌ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ حِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ. فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا [الفرقان: 19] يَقُولُ: الْمُشْرِكُونَ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا [الفرقان: 19] "
Edition record 372881 · p. 497Link to report ↗

10

“And the Day the heaven will split open with clouds and the angels…”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 25:25).

13
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 13

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Ali ibn Zayd ibn Judan, from Yusuf ibn Mihran, from Ibn Abbas, on the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
And the Day the heaven will split open with clouds and the angels will be sent down in a descent [al-Furqan 25] he said: "The people of the nearest heaven will come down, and they are more numerous than all who are on earth of jinn and humans. The people of the earth will say to them: 'Is our Lord, Mighty and Majestic, among you?' They will say: 'No, but He is coming.' Then the second heaven will split open and its people will come down, and they are more numerous than the people of the nearest heaven and than the people of the earth, their jinn and their humans. They will say: 'Is our Lord among you?' They will say: 'No, but He is coming.' Then the heavens will split open in the same way, each heaven more numerous than those beneath them of the angels of the heavens and the people of the earth. Then the seventh heaven will split open and its people will come down, and they are more numerous than the people of the six heavens and than the people of the earth, their jinn and their humans. They will say: 'Is our Lord, Mighty and Majestic, among you?' They will say: 'No, but He is coming.' Then the Lord, Mighty and Majestic, will descend among the Cherubim, who are more numerous than the people of the seven heavens and than the people of the earth, among the bearers of the Throne. They have ankles like the shafts of spears; between the sole of one of them and his ankle is a journey of five hundred years, from his ankle to his knee a journey of five hundred years, from his knee to the tip of his nose a journey of five hundred years, from the tip of his nose to his collarbone a journey of five hundred years, and from his collarbone to the place of the earring a journey of five hundred years." [The text of this report is cut off at this point in the transmitted edition; the page numbering jumps from 498 to 503.]
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عز وجل:
وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَاءُ بِالْغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ تَنْزِيلًا [الفرقان: 25] قَالَ: " يَنْزِلُ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا، وَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ مِمَّنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ، فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْأَرْضِ: أَفِيكُمْ رَبُّنَا عز وجل؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: لَا وَسَيَأْتِي، ثُمَّ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَاءُ الثَّانِيَةُ فَيَنْزِلُ أَهْلُهَا، وَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا، وَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ جِنِّهِمْ وَإِنْسِهِمْ، فَيَقُولُونَ: أَفِيكُمْ رَبُّنَا؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: لَا وَسَيَأْتِي، ثُمَّ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَوَاتُ كَذَلِكَ، كُلُّ سَمَاءٍ أَكْثَرُ مِمَّنْ تَحْتِهِمْ مِنْ مَلَائِكَةِ السَّمَوَاتِ، وَمَنْ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ، ثُمَّ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَاءُ السَّابِعَةُ، وَيَنْزِلُ أَهْلُهَا وَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّمَوَاتِ السِّتِّ، وَمَنْ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ جِنِّهِمْ وَإِنْسِهِمْ، فَيَقُولُونَ: أَفِيكُمْ رَبُّنَا عز وجل؟ فَيَقُولُونَ: لَا وَسَيَأْتِي، ثُمَّ يَنْزِلُ الرَّبُّ عز وجل فِي الْكُرُوبِيِّينَ، وَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ فِي حَمَلَةِ الْعَرْشِ، لَهُمْ كُعُوبٌ كَكُعُوبِ الْقَنَا مَا بَيْنَ أَخْمَصِ أَحَدِهِمْ إِلَى كَعْبِهِ مَسِيرَةَ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ، وَمِنْ كَعْبِهِ إِلَى رُكْبَتِهِ مَسِيرَةَ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ، وَمِنْ رُكْبَتِهِ إِلَى أَرْنَبَتِهِ مَسِيرَةَ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ، وَمِنْ أَرْنَبَتِهِ إِلَى تَرْقُوَتِهِ مَسِيرَةَ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ، وَمِنْ تَرْقُوَتِهِ إِلَى مَوْضِعِ الْقُرْطِ مَسِيرَةَ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ "» »

11

“And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 25:27).

15
Explanation from Mujāhid 15

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
The shaykh and imam Abu al-Saud al-Mubarak ibn Khayrun ibn Abd al-Malik ibn al-Hasan ibn Khayrun informed us, by recitation to him while I listened, and he affirmed it on Saturday, the seventeenth of Jumada al-Ula of the year 541 [AH]; he said: Abu al-Fadl Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Khayrun informed us in Shawwal of the year 482 [sic]; he said: Abu Ali al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn Ibrahim ibn al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Shadhan informed us; he said: Abu al-Qasim Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ubayd ibn Abd al-Malik al-Hamadhani, the judge, informed me; he said: Abu Ishaq Ibrahim ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Hamadhani related to us, saying: Adam ibn Abi Iyas related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [al-Furqan 27] he said: It was revealed concerning Uqba ibn Abi Muayt. That is because he invited a gathering that included the Prophet ﷺ and the Prophet ﷺ said: "I will not eat until you testify that there is no god but God and that I am the Messenger of God." Uqba did so. Ubayy ibn Khalaf met him and said to him: "Have you apostatized?" Uqba said to him: "Your brother is as you know, but he refused to eat until I said it to him, so I said it, though it is not in my heart."
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ الْإِمَامُ أَبُو السُّعُودِ الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ خَيْرُونَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خَيْرُونَ، قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ، وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ، فَأَقَرَّ بِهِ فِي يَوْمِ السَّبْتِ سَابِعِ عَشَرَ جُمَادَى الْأُولَى مِنْ سَنَةِ إِحْدِى وَأَرْبَعِينَ وَخَمْسِمِائَةٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْفَضْلِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خَيْرُونَ فِي شَوَّالٍ مِنْ سَنَةِ اثْنَتَيْنِ وَثَمَانِينَ وَأَرْبَعِمِائَةٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ، قَالَ: أنبأ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْهَمَذَانِيُّ الْقَاضِي، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْهَمَذَانِيُّ، ثنا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ [الفرقان: 27] قَالَ: نَزَلَتْ فِي عُقْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ دَعَا مَجْلِسًا فِيهِمُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: " لَا آكُلُ حَتَّى تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَفَعَلَ عُقْبَةُ فَلَقِيَهُ أُبَيُّ بْنُ خَلَفٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: أَصَبَوْتَ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُقْبَةُ: إِنَّ أَخَاكَ عَلَى مَا تَعْلَمُ، وَلَكِنَّهُ أَبَى أَنْ يَأْكُلَ حَتَّى أَقُولَهُ لَهُ، فَقُلْتُهُ، وَلَيْسَ فِي نَفْسِي "
